description: This file defines a singleton class `LocalDb` that manages local SQLite database access using the sqflite package. It provides methods for initializing the database, creating the attendance table, and clearing its contents, functioning as a data source for attendance records in a student attendance tracker app.

classes.name: LocalDb
classes.description: A singleton class providing access to the local SQLite database for attendance data.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the database by creating the attendance table if it does not already exist.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Deletes all entries from the attendance table, mainly used for development or testing.

calls: db.execute('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_attendance_date ON attendance(date)')
